gridDNA: Flat-lay arrangement of two distinct product groups on a natural grass background, each associated with a handwritten sticky note, all positioned above a prominent, centrally-aligned text block with a dark gradient overlay at the bottom.

zones.note: provides a natural, slightly informal context

zones.note: represents the 'paid' portion of the offer

zones.position: top-right, starting 12% from top, ending 21% from right
zones.treatment: yellow sticky note with handwritten text and arrow
zones.note: visually links to the top-left product group, indicating the 'buy' quantity

zones.position: mid-canvas, starting 38% from top, 14% from left
zones.note: represents the 'free' portion of the offer

zones.position: mid-left, starting 40% from top, 21% from left
zones.treatment: yellow sticky note with handwritten text and arrow
zones.note: visually links to the mid-canvas product group, indicating the 'free' quantity

zones.position: bottom 35% of canvas, starting 65% from top
zones.treatment: dark gradient overlay, fading into the grass
zones.note: provides contrast and readability for the text block

zones.treatment: large, bold, white sans-serif text, all caps, on dark overlay
zones.note: summarizes the core offer with high impact

zones.treatment: smaller, white sans-serif text, mixed case, on dark overlay
zones.note: provides context for the headline offer

zones.treatment: tiny, white sans-serif text, mixed case, on dark overlay

typeScale: headline ~8% of canvas height, subheadline ~2.5%, legal ~1.2%
colourBlocking: Top 65% features a natural green grass background with products and yellow sticky notes. The bottom 35% is a dark, semi-transparent gradient overlay providing a high-contrast backdrop for white text.
negativeSpace: Ample negative space around the product groups and sticky notes on the grass background, allowing each element to stand out. The dark text block at the bottom also uses negative space effectively around the headline for impact.
eyePath: Top-left product group -> top-right sticky note -> mid-left sticky note -> mid-canvas product group -> large headline -> subheadline -> legal text.
whyItWins: The clear visual distinction between 'buy' and 'get free' product quantities, reinforced by handwritten notes, immediately communicates a compelling value proposition before the main headline confirms the offer.
